records.Name: Alpine Peak 2 Tent

records.Name: Summit Trail 65 Backpack
records.Description: A 65-liter internal frame backpacking pack with an adjustable torso ladder system and a load-lifter suspension.

records.Name: BlazeLight Camp Stove
records.Description: A compact canister camp stove with piezo ignition and a folding tripod base.

records.Name: Frostguard 20 Sleeping Bag
records.Description: A 20-degree Fahrenheit down mummy bag with a mesh storage sack for long-term loft retention.

records.Description: A rechargeable 500-lumen headlamp with red night-vision and strobe modes, charged via USB-C.

records.Name: Ridgeline Hiking Boots
records.Description: A mid-height waterproof hiking boot with a Vibram outsole, built for multi-day trail use.

records.Name: BaseCamp Quad Chair
